Dashboard 223 224 ) 225 } 226 ``` 227 228 229 230 ### `scroll` 231 232 **Defaults to `true`.** The default scrolling behavior of `` in Next.js **is to maintain scroll position**, similar to how When you navigate to a new [Page](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/page), scroll position will stay the same as long as the Page is visible in the viewport. For static routes, the full route will be prefetched (including all its data).
